limitations: This is a small local adapter-training pilot on synthetic transactions; improvement is measured, not guaranteed.
The MLX base uses a different 4-bit representation from the earlier Ollama benchmark; all four learning conditions share the identical MLX base.
Compute limits, errors, and incomplete attempts are unscored. Compare success rates together with scored coverage.
RL training adds a bounded semantic potential difference to binary terminal reward. It does not claim reward invariance; held-out success uses the unchanged binary verifier.
Fixed final checkpoints are selected without sealed-test feedback. Validation loss is diagnostic; equal-reward rollout groups produce no optimizer update.

training_memory.layer_gradients: materialized one layer at a time; no full-model gradient trace
training_memory.attention_forward_inputs: host-backed constants with explicit custom VJP

rl.additional_trigger: After eight primary groups, run all eight additional groups only if fewer than two optimizer updates occurred.
rl.selection: last completed update after predeclared groups
rl.shaping_scope: train only; semantic records, not activity counts; no policy-invariance claim
rl.unscored_outcomes: excluded from rewards, advantages, and scoring denominators

preflight.selection: Shortest and longest tokenized TRAIN rows; disposable infrastructure checkpoint, never selected for evaluation.

config.selection: Open once after all validation evaluations and final checkpoint hashes are frozen; never train or select checkpoints using test results.
